Apple accelerates security updates due to AI cybersecurity concerns

Apple has announced it is releasing security updates earlier than its usual schedule in response to emerging cybersecurity threats related to artificial intelligence. This change deviates from the company's previous practice of bundling security fixes with broader software releases. The company stated that the latest security updates are now available to all users.
